summary_en: Ransom-note letters and torn-paper cut-outs tell why cats moved in with us, animated at 12 fps with a three-frame edge boil.
limits_en: The cat and mice are paper cut-out assemblies with simple swinging legs and no fine expressions.
The jump frames 73, 75, 78 and 155 flagged by the automated check are the title paper being pulled away and caption changes: by design.
At 12 fps stop-motion, frame differences within a beat are close to 0; the style requires it.
